query:
-- Verificar clientes ativos com cotas que NÃO têm login no sistema (não aparecem em users)
SELECT 
  ac.id,
  ac.name,
  ac.email AS email_cadastrado,
  COUNT(cq.id) AS total_quotas,
  'SEM LOGIN NO SISTEMA' AS situacao
FROM allowed_clients ac
LEFT JOIN users u ON LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(ac.email)
LEFT JOIN client_quotas cq ON cq.client_id = ac.id AND cq.is_active = 1
WHERE ac.is_active = 1 AND u.id IS NULL AND cq.id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ac.id, ac.name, ac.email
ORDER BY ac.name;
